svg.title: Native TreeSHAP interactions
svg.desc: football-csv | PL | fixed output H - A | 32 holdout rows 2026-03-21 to 2026-04-25 | model 248ab51bf6b5 | run 3c493184a1e17c956bc9 Diagonal: mean absolute main effect. Off diagonal: mean absolute total pair interaction (twice one native half-cell). All feature pairs, including omitted features, remain in interaction-pairs.csv. Statistical significance and causal effects are not inferred.
